reading.title: Screens and the teenage brain
reading.text: Few topics divide parents and scientists like screen time. Psychologists warn that constant notifications put teenagers under psychological pressure, while biologists point out that the adolescent brain is still developing. Technology companies reply that their products help young people stay connected. The logic of a total ban is attractive, but most experts believe it would fail. Instead, they recommend an open dialogue at home: parents and children agree on rules together, and adults apologise when they break the rules themselves.
